# Island Hub Caribbean Market

> Family-run Caribbean grocery store on Midlothian Turnpike in Richmond, Virginia. "Everything from yawd." Jamaican at heart, with foods from across the Caribbean on the shelves. Ships barrels, boxes and crates to every Caribbean island, and ships grocery orders to all US states.

## Contact and location
- Name: Island Hub Caribbean Market
- Address: 6856 Midlothian Turnpike, Ste 104, Richmond, VA 23225 (Midlothian Turnpike, Southside Richmond)
- Phone: (804) 716-5480 (call or text)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/islandhub_/ (@islandhub_)
- Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/biz/island-hub-caribbean-market-richmond
- Website: https://island-hub-caribbean-market.netlify.app/
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Island+Hub+Caribbean+Market%2C+6856+Midlothian+Turnpike+Ste+104%2C+Richmond%2C+VA+23225

## Hours (America/New_York)
- Monday to Wednesday: 9am to 8pm
- Thursday to Saturday: 9am to 9pm
- Sunday: 9am to 5pm
- Open 7 days a week. Holiday hours may differ.

## About
- Opened in May 2023. Family-run, founded by Carlton Chambers and his daughter Tracy.
- Jamaican at heart, the whole Caribbean on the shelves: Trinidadian drinks, Guyanese chow mein, Haitian favorites, African goods and more.
- Google rating: 4.8 from 48 reviews.

## What they sell (stock changes; follow Instagram for restocks)
- Spices and bush teas: Grace, National and Angel Brand spices; cerasee, guinea hen weed, moringa, soursop leaf, neem, mauby bark, chew stick, bissy, pimento, allspice, nutmeg, isinglass, senna, linseed, arrowroot; Clover, Caribbean Dreams and Shavuot herbal teas.
- Bakery and patties: Golden Krust Easter bun, butter bread, coco bread, sugar buns, Jamaican-style chicken and jerk chicken patties (frozen), Grace franks.
- Snacks and sweets: plantain and banana chips, Nibbles cookies, Kiss cakes and cupcakes, Cheese Trix and cheese curls, tamarind balls.
- Drinks and ice cream: Juiciful box drinks, coconut water, Rude Boy, Serge full cream milk, Supligen. Jamaican ice cream flavors: Rum & Raisin, Grape-Nut, Cherry Rum Nut, Eggnog, Irish Moss, Soursop, Stout, Pistachio Grape-Nut, Cookies & Cream.
- Fresh produce and seasonal: callaloo, breadfruit, yellow yam, sorrel (seasonal, around Christmas).
- Pantry: Grace syrups (strawberry, cherry, kola champagne, pineapple orange), Grace staples, authentic Jamaican escoveitch pickled sauce, Seven Seas cod liver oil.
- Games and culture: Ludi boards, dominoes, island flag apparel, frankincense and myrrh.

## Shipping services
- "We Ship Box & Barrels." Barrels, boxes and crates shipped to every Caribbean island (barrels, boxes, appliances, groceries, general goods).
- Shipping barrels are sold in store.
- Barrel pickup in and around Richmond (RVA). Fees apply.
- Grocery orders shipped to all US states. Perishable items ship overnight.
- Rates, transit times and carriers are not published. Every shipment is quoted: call or text (804) 716-5480, message @islandhub_ on Instagram, or use the quote form at https://island-hub-caribbean-market.netlify.app/shipping.html#quote

## Prices and ordering
- Shelf prices in store; no price list is published online.
- No online store or checkout. Order by walking in, calling or texting (804) 716-5480, or sending an Instagram direct message.
- Item requests: https://island-hub-caribbean-market.netlify.app/visit.html#request

## FAQ
- Do I need an appointment? No, walk in during store hours.
- Do you only carry Jamaican food? No, the shelves cover the whole Caribbean plus African goods.
- Do you ship barrels to the Caribbean? Yes, to every Caribbean island. Call or message for a quote.
- Do you sell barrels? Yes, in store.
- Can you pick up my barrel? Yes, in and around Richmond, VA. Fees apply.
- Can you ship groceries to another state? Yes, to all states. Perishables ship overnight.
- Can I order online? No online checkout; call, text or DM on Instagram.
